'''2009 Bespin Regionals Colin Campbell LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Colin Campbell]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|Ref3-L-wellhandlethis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Perpetual Motion Squad
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
